reason: Insufficiently uncertain? no—README explicitly positions this as a usage-monitoring plugin: it shows provider token-plan/余额 in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar footer and provides a settings area for provider-specific query configuration, with explicit support for DeepSeek Platform and OpenCode Go.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏展示不同供应商的 API 余额或 Token 用量卡片，并提供按供应商配置查询参数（如 API Key / Cookie）的设置入口。
summaries.en: This plugin shows provider API balance or token-plan usage in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar and provides a settings area to configure provider-specific query parameters such as API keys and cookies.

capabilities: Reads user-configured credentials/params for provider APIs
Queries external provider endpoints to retrieve balance or token-plan usage
Displays usage summaries in a sidebar card and settings section
Persists provider configuration in settings storage
